newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers rebound, seen rising further.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers rebound, seen rising further.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices rebounded with crude from Tuesday's plunge with sellers optimistic that prices would climb further later Wednesday, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst were quoted at $122-$123 per tonne and 180-cst at around $128 per tonne.
Majors said the market remained quite with most buyers still "testing the waters". But they expect activities to pick up later Wednesday.
MDO was steady at $222-$226 but gasoil edged higher at around $238-$244 from $236/$242 on Tuesday on the back of the stronger cargo market. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
